messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — queue_length_inference > 5000 (5m avg) for cell inference-hot-1. policy: pd-oncall -> escalation
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 fired (High) — On-call: alice. :bell:
alice: I'm looking. seeing sustained queue backlog and scale-controller not provisioning nodes. k8s events show pods Pending due to quota errors.
ben: seeing same. nodepool reports "quotaExceeded" from cloud provider. ETA for quota increase unknown.
carol: customer-facing note — a few large customers seeing 5xxs and higher tail latency. already notified CS to hold outbound comms.
dinesh: logs from scale controller:
```
I0317 15:02:10 scale_controller.go:312] failed to create nodegroup: quotaExceeded: insufficient vcpu quota
I0317 15:03:05 scale_controller.go:402] retrying scale up
```
alice: trying manual warm-up: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-cell-frontend --replicas=40` — will also attempt to spin up a fallback pool.
ben: manual replicas applied but pods Pending — cloud API rejecting create. opening provider support ticket. ticket #SUP-4892.
carol: any mitigation for customer impact short-term? can we reroute traffic to region B?
dinesh: we can re-route via smart-router policy to inference-west-2 but capacity there is limited. proposing: 1) create temporary lower-capacity fallback model (quantized) 2) shift non-critical traffic to west-2 3) keep HQ customers on canary.
alice: executing 1 and 2. applying router override now.
incident-bot: Router override applied: route inference-hot-1 -> inference-west-2 (10% traffic). :white_check_mark:
ben: provider support says quota increase may take 3-6 hours. not helpful for immediate.
carol: CS update sent to affected customers: "We're experiencing degraded inference throughput in us-east; traffic is being rerouted; engineers are actively mitigating." :envelope_with_arrow:
alice: dinesh, if west-2 fills up, fallback plan to degrade to smaller model families to preserve throughput. I'll start rollout.
dinesh: started quantized model build: will push variant q4_8bit to dedicated pool. log: `push_success: inference-cell-q4_8bit:v1`
ben: temporary autoscaler policy override proposed: allow burst nodes from on-demand pool (if quota available) and reduce cool-downs. applying now.
alice: applied autoscaler override and lowered stabilization window to 30s. monitoring.
pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by alice.
carol: tracking metrics: queue_length 5m avg dropped from 5400 -> 2100 after router override and manual steps. latency P95 still elevated (1.8s -> 1.6s).
ben: still seeing ~300 pods stuck in Pending. cloud shows spot pool constrained.
alice: escalating to platform team for quota resolution. @dinesh please ping infra-sre if provider support stalls.
dinesh: pinged infra-sre and provider rep; included logs and support ticket.
incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled in 35 minutes. alice -> ben. If still active, do handoff in thread.
ben: taking interim on-call if handoff happens. will keep monitoring.
carol: compiling incident timeline and customer impact notes for post-incident comms.
alice: current mitigation status: 1) router override 10% -> west-2 2) quantized fallback pushed 3) autoscaler override applied 4) manual replicas applied; queue length decreasing but not resolved. next: persist routing if stable, continue pressure test, escalate billing/quota.
ben: adding runbook steps executed to the thread for RCA later. :memo:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Reminder — incident still open. :alarm_clock:
carol: update after 20m: queue 5m avg -> 900. customer 503s reduced from 120/min -> 8/min. good progress.
alice: preparing to handoff to ben in 10 minutes; leaving notes: primary mitigation = router override + q4_8bit rollback if quality issues. handover checklist in thread now.
ben: acked. I'll take it from here; will escalate to infra if quota not increased in next 2h. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed? No — mark when resolved.
